title: Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Engines by Year
description: Every factory engine in the Chevrolet Silverado 1500 by year, 1999–2026: Vortec V6 and V8s, the SS 6.0, the 6.2 V8, 2.7 TurboMax, Duramax 3.0 and the EV.
intro: The Silverado replaced the C/K 1500 for 1999 and has been built in four generations. This page covers the half-ton Silverado 1500; the 1500HD of 2001–2007 was built on the heavy-duty chassis and is not included.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: GMT800
intro: The first Silverado used the 4.3 V6 and Vortec 4.8, 5.3 and 6.0 V8s. The 2003–2007 Silverado SS used a 345 hp 6.0, and a mild hybrid ran from 2004.

generations.name: GMT900
intro: The GMT900 arrived for 2007, when the old body was also sold as the Silverado Classic. Later trucks offered Active Fuel Management V8s up to the 6.2 and a two-mode hybrid from 2009.

generations.name: K2XX
intro: The K2XX brought direct-injected EcoTec3 engines: the 4.3 V6, 5.3 V8 and 6.2 V8.

generations.name: T1
intro: The current Silverado offers the 2.7 turbo four, the 5.3 and 6.2 V8s with Dynamic Fuel Management and a 3.0 Duramax diesel, plus the electric Silverado EV from 2024. The old body was sold for 2019 as the Silverado LD.
